drafts.subject: the skid steer doesn't take messages
drafts.body:
Hey Morgan,

most hardscape owners I talk to already tried an answering service or some chatbot for the phones, and it made things worse instead of better.

you're two hours into a paver base, the phone buzzes twice, and by the time you're off the skid steer that homeowner already called the next crew on the list.

how many of those do you figure slip by in a week?

Sam
